m26_forward_state.m26_caveat: M26.11 starts a production-activation contract chain but still denies live provider calls, verified final answers, public traffic and production pointer mutation. M25 final closure remains separately required for any stage that requires m25_closed.

residual_risks: M25.8 and M25.9 readiness gates remain recorded as blocked in their original control-plane artifacts and are treated as superseded by the exact M25.10 live blog path, not silently passed.
Public production traffic is not authorized and has no target hostname/path in the M25 closure evidence.
Production runtime still uses the authenticated internal M25 route and candidate-authority Qdrant payload filter; full public answer serving remains outside M25 authority.
Cost and reviewer throughput evidence is sufficient for bounded decision-making only; expanded or continuous ingestion requires new measured runs and Daniel approval.
M26.11 forward work exists on main and must not be interpreted as M25 final closure.
